results.question: How do I roll back a service?

answer.answer: To roll back a service, choose the previous production digest and create a new deployment. Keep in mind that a rollback will not undo database migrations.

citations.quote: To roll back a service, select the previous production digest and create a new deployment.

retrieved.text: To roll back a service, select the previous production digest and create a new deployment. Rollback does not undo database migrations. A migration that deletes a column must wait until the old application version no longer reads it.

After all callers use the replacement key, revoke the old key and check that an old-key request receives HTTP 401. A new-key request must still succeed. A configuration rollout alone does not establish that the old credential was revoked.

results.question: Does deleting a documentation page delete its vectors?

answer.answer: No, removing a page from the website does not remove its stored vectors.

citations.quote: Removing a page from the website does not remove its stored vectors.

retrieved.text: Delete every chunk ID belonging to the removed document from each active search generation. Removing a page from the website does not remove its stored vectors. Run the deletion check before accepting another search request.

A documentation reader key can read published pages but cannot update the search index. The indexing job uses a separate credential. A metadata filter in a search request does not replace the service's authorization check.

Batch text within the embedding model's context limit. Character-based splitting is not a token limit. If the embedding service rejects an input, reduce the chunk size and rebuild the affected generation rather than silently truncating the document.
